truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 found 11 true vulnerabilities fully, 3 partially, and missed 6. It overclaimed severity on several true findings and misclassified several CWEs. One added admin-exec finding is overclaimed as a standalone unprivileged vulnerability relative to the visible truth list.

Items.Notes: The Run 2 finding cited runtime_log_format() and printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input), matching the true format-string injection anchor.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: A large user-supplied argument causes a long factorial loop and signed integer overflow, enabling denial of service and undefined behavior.
Items.Notes: Run 2 recognized factorial signed integer overflow at result *= i, but framed it primarily as uncontrolled resource consumption and under-rated the integer-overflow severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free of memory-pool scratch buffer during cleanup
Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly linked stage_deferred_history_flush scratch allocation, queued sleep_for task, and memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup.
Run 2 cited validator_cmd + config_file and system(command.c_str()), matching the config validation command-injection anchor.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Stack buffer overflow via inverted length check in evaluate_expression
Items.Notes: Run 2 found the inverted strcpy path and separately the safe_string_copy dest[src_len] NUL-write issue, matching the true stack/OOB input-processing vulnerability.
Run 2 cited read before lock and write-back under mutex, matching the thread-pool counter race.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Authentication bypass via EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE after failed attempts
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, and authenticated_ = true, but labeled it authentication bypass rather than the intentional logic bomb and over-rated severity.
Run 2 did not identify config_dir_ + filename path traversal in ConfigLoader::load_config.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Heap buffer overflow via unbounded strcpy in ExpressionParser::parse
Items.Notes: Run 2 cited buffer_size_ = 256, pool allocation, and strcpy into expression_buffer_, matching the parser heap overflow.
Run 2 cited ADMIN_SECRET = SC_ENT_2025_AUTH, matching the hardcoded credential vulnerability, but over-rated severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Session tokens have only four decimal digits of entropy, making them easy to brute force or predict.
Items.Notes: Run 2 found weak low-entropy session tokens but did not explicitly identify std::mt19937 as the weak PRNG root cause or use CWE-338.
Run 2 did not identify the unsynchronized static std::tm cached_time and localtime update in log_debug_message.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: OS command injection in emergency audit logging via environment variable
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified TEMP/TMPDIR embedded in a system() command for supercalc_emergency.log, but framed it as command injection rather than insecure temporary file handling.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ state without expiry as a session-state vulnerability.
Run 2 did not identify unhandled std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer underflow in MemoryPool split allocation can create out-of-bounds block
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES underflow and fragment.size = remaining, but used CWE-190 instead of CWE-191.
Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursive parse_expression/parse_factor on PAREN_OPEN tokens.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Data race in ExpressionEvaluator::evaluate_cached result cache
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified result_cache_ access/mutation without cache_mutex_ under concurrent thread-pool calls, but over-rated severity as High instead of Medium.
Run 2 did not identify exists/sleep_for/ifstream TOCTOU in ConfigLoader::load_config.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Division by zero in calculate_route_score for empty input
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length) with token_length = 0 for empty input.
